cce.extension.deployed.evidence: API 18005: Require the existing scalar instanceName input and select an exact name from records. Duplicate names across namespaces are errors; callers can narrow namespace. pending-install, pending-upgrade, pending-rollback and uninstalling remain pending.

cce.extension.uninstalled.evidence: API 18005: Require the existing scalar instanceName input and select an exact name from records. Duplicate names across namespaces are errors; callers can narrow namespace. pending-install, pending-upgrade, pending-rollback and uninstalling remain pending.

cce.node.ready.evidence: API 19173: Required cluster and node path identities scope one node. normal healthy and abnormal unhealthy are explicit; expulsion remains pending. The example-only delete_fail value is not inferred as a documented terminal state.

cce.v1-ccse.cluster.ready.evidence: API 10733: The existing clusterName query input is required by an exact name selector. Creation, resizing, upgrade and deletion transitions remain pending; duplicate names are rejected rather than selecting a row.

api_scope.notes: Published self-operated customer-side container engine APIs. Historical cce and ccse v1.1 families remain separate command groups; the v1.2 autoscaling operation has an explicit additional prefix.

parameters.description: 云主机或物理机，用户登录密码，如果loginType=password，这该项为必填项，满足以下规则： 物理机：用户密码，满足以下规则：长度在8～30个字符； 必须包含大小写字母和（至少一个数字或者特殊字符）； 特殊符号可选：()`~!@#$%&*_-+=\ 云主机：长度在8～30个字符； 必须包含大写字母、小写字母、数字以及特殊符号中的三项； 特殊符号可选：()`-!@#$%^&*_-+=｜{}[]:;' ,.?/且不能以斜线号 / 开头； 不能包含3个及以上连续字符； 纳管节点时password字段可选择加密，具体加密方法请参见 password字段加密的方法
